messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: S1 | HTTP 5xx error-rate spike detected in us-west-2 for service=inference-gateway. Threshold breached: 2.5% 5xx over 3m. Pager: rotation-eng. Auto-page initiated.
Ben (oncall): Acked. I'm on it. pinging infra and runtime.
Ben (oncall): Quick check — is this global or just us-west?
Alice M: I'm seeing elevated 502s from the gateway logs in us-west and a smaller bump in eu-west. Looks like spike originated in upstream edge.
Dave Ops: Running quick health checks. `kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=gateway -o wide` shows a few `CrashLoopBackOff` on node gw-usw2-3.
Carla S: copying runbook: `incidents/runbooks/gateway-5xx.md` — recommend: isolate, scale, and route traffic to us-east.
Ben (oncall): Scaling gateway replica set now to 6 from 3 for us-west. `kubectl scale deploy/gateway --replicas=6 -n inference`
Ben (oncall): Also enabling emergency routing slice to us-east: `redwood route set --service inference-gateway --slice stable --region us-east1 --weight 30`
Dave Ops: FYI logs show consistent `upstream read: connection reset by peer` from the auth-proxy sidecar. Pasting snippet: ```ERROR auth-proxy: upstream read failed: connection reset by peer at 2026-03-12T23:00:05Z
ERROR auth-proxy: unexpected EOF while reading response
```
Alice M: That matches an increased latency from the internal auth service. Could be thread exhaustion or a middleware bug.
Ben (oncall): Tested a couple of curl requests against a problematic host, getting 502 consistently: `curl -i https://gw-usw2-3.redwood.internal/api/health` -> HTTP/1.1 502
Carla S: Do we have any recent deploys in us-west? CI deploys show a canary finished ~20m ago for `auth-proxy:v2.3.1` — not rolled out to everyone but the canary hosts are in us-west.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Escalation triggered to SRE rotation (Carla S) due to ack timeout.
Carla S: On it — rolling the canary back. `kubectl rollout undo deploy/auth-proxy -n infra --to-revision=15`
Dave Ops: Rolling back now, will monitor logs. Also increasing probe timeout for auth-proxy to reduce false restarts: patching readinessProbe to `periodSeconds:10, failureThreshold:6`
Ben (oncall): Traffic slice now routed 40% to us-east. Seeing overall 5xx drop from 2.5% -> 0.9% in the last 2 minutes. Good signal.
Alice M: Customer impact check: No major API partners reported errors yet. Observability shows small spike in user-facing 5xx for a handful of sessions — estimated <0.1% of requests affected.
Carla S: Rollback confirmed; auth-proxy pods transitioning to ready on the canary hosts. Logs show fewer connection resets.
Ben (oncall): Keeping pages suppressed for 15m; will let PD auto-unmute when baseline recovered. Adding a quick note to the incident channel. @oncall-next please standby for handoff at 04:00 UTC.
Dave Ops: Quick mitigation note to add to runbook: when canary auth-proxy causes reset loop, prefer rollback + probe tweak before node drains. I'll open a PR to the runbook.
Alice M: Also capturing the correlation id map for the affected traces, saving to s3: `s3://redwood-incident-dumps/1734561111/trace-loglines.gz`
Ben (oncall): Preparing a short customer-facing status blurb in #general-status — keep it factual: briefly describe limited latency/errors in us-west and that traffic was routed to other regions, rollback performed, monitoring in progress.
Carla S: Agreed. I'll draft and Ben can send.
Ben (oncall): Status update posted. Notifying account teams for any high-touch customers.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Alert resolved (service: inference-gateway) — error-rate back below threshold for 5m. Incident will be archived after 1h if no regression.
Alice M: Leaving a follow-up item: run deeper memory/thread profiling of auth-proxy canaries; create test that simulates auth-proxy upstream connection churn.
Dave Ops: Created ticket INF-5891 for follow-up and assigned to infra-team.
Ben (oncall): Handoff: I'm wrapping up here — everything stable. Carla will follow through with postmortem and runbook updates. Oncall next is @Eve (night): please pick up if anything regresses.
Carla S: Will own postmortem. Tentative timeline: publish a 1-pager within 24h, detailed RCA in 72h. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
